title: chaetoseris hastata
intro: Chaetoseris hastata, commonly known as Snow Cabbage or Chinese Cabbage, is a type of flowering plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It is used in traditional Chinese medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving fever, and promoting digestion. The therapeutic actions of Chaetoseris hastata are attributed to its ability to clear heat and toxins from the body, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antipyretic properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and triterpenoids, which have been shown to have antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
